tokens.name: background

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Default text on `background`, `card` and `popover`.

tokens.name: card-foreground

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Dropdown, dialog and sheet surface.

tokens.name: popover-foreground

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Brand indigo as a FILL: primary buttons, active stat card, focus ring. Never for body text; use `primary-strong`.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `primary` fill. Dark in both themes.

tokens.name: primary-strong
tokens.usage: Brand indigo as a FOREGROUND: links, the `.app` wordmark accent, icons on tinted rows. Source measures it at 4.5:1 or better on every surface it lands on (a11y/primary-text-contrast test).

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Magenta-pink, the gradient's end stop; secondary accents.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `secondary`. Source's light pair is dark-on-pink; dark theme pairs light text with a pink of the same lightness, so check contrast before using on dark.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Quiet surface: skeletons, chips at rest, table stripes.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text and captions on `background`, `card` and `muted`.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Hover and selected-state surface for rows, menu items and tabs. Dark value is lifted to 0.28 so hover stays visible on `card`.

tokens.name: accent-foreground

tokens.name: destructive
